text: better, chiller

Ich fühle mich viel geliebter und verbundener mit meinen Freunden und meiner Familie. Das hat meine psychische Gesundheit sehr verbessert. Ich hatte früher oft Phasen, in denen ich mich sehr einsam gefühlt habe, obwohl ich eigentlich viele Menschen um mich herum hatte. Ich habe einfach niemanden an mich herangelassen. Seit der Erfahrung ist das anders. Ich spüre die Liebe der Menschen um mich herum und kann sie annehmen. Ich bin dankbarer für meine Freundschaften und nehme mir mehr Zeit für sie. Auch die Trauer um meinen Vater konnte ich dadurch besser verarbeiten, weil ich nicht allein damit war. Ich habe heute weniger depressive Phasen und fühle mich insgesamt glücklicher und lebendiger als vor der Erfahrung.
Nothing I could notice.
My mental health is better because I'm not pretending anymore. I'm less anxious and I sleep better. I feel more real.
Ich bin entspannter und habe mehr Freude an den kleinen Dingen. Mein Alltag fühlt sich leichter an.

My mental health has improved since the experience, though it's been a gradual process. The biggest change is that I understand myself now. For years I thought I was just an anxious, people-pleasing person, and that this was my personality. Now I see that it was a survival strategy from my childhood. That understanding has been a huge relief. I'm less ashamed and more compassionate with myself. My anxiety has decreased, especially in relationships. I used to panic whenever my partner was in a bad mood, thinking I had to fix it, and now I can let him have his feelings. I've also become more open to exploring my emotions, which I always avoided. Therapy has been really helpful, and I think the experience made me ready for it. I'm not completely healed, but I feel like I'm finally on the right path.
I'm less anxious and happier in general. I enjoy my life more.
Ebenfalls schwer zu sagen.

The experience improved my mental health in a lasting way. The feeling of love and connection I felt during the ceremony is still with me, two years later. I feel more connected to the people I love and to nature, and I'm less anxious because of it. I used to have a lot of social anxiety, and now I find it easier to open up to people. I've stayed in touch with some of the people from the ceremony, and we meet regularly to talk about our lives and our experiences. That community has been really important to me. I'm also more grateful for my life and for the beauty of the world. I go hiking almost every weekend now, and every time I'm in the mountains I feel that same sense of connection and peace. My rumination has gone down a lot, and I sleep much better.
I've become more reflective, which is good, but I don't think my mental health has changed much overall.
Ich bin weniger angespannt und kann mich besser abgrenzen. Ich fühle mich wohler in meiner Familie, weil ich nicht mehr das Gefühl habe, alles regeln zu müssen.

I'm much less burnt out and more satisfied with my job. I feel more compassion and love, not just for my students, but for people in general, and that has made me happier. I'm also more open to new teaching methods and ideas, which has made my job more interesting again. I used to dread Mondays, and now I mostly look forward to seeing the kids.
Happier

Ich habe weniger Ängste und mehr Vertrauen in mich selbst. Das hat meine psychische Gesundheit stark verbessert. Ich bin mutiger geworden und traue mir Dinge zu, die ich früher nie gewagt hätte, wie die Selbstständigkeit. Ich bin offener für neue Erfahrungen und Menschen und habe das Gefühl, dass mein Leben reicher geworden ist. Ich verstehe auch besser, wie meine Ängste entstanden sind, und kann sie deshalb leichter loslassen.
I'm less anxious and less lonely now that I talk about my feelings. My mood has improved a lot.

At first my mental health got worse. I was very emotional, cried a lot, and couldn't concentrate. It felt like everything I'd buried came up at once. But over time, with a lot of support, I worked through it, and now I'm much healthier than I was before. I understand myself better, I'm less anxious, and I'm more at peace with my past.
Ich bin ruhiger und ausgeglichener geworden. Meine Stimmung ist stabiler, und ich habe weniger Ängste.

My social anxiety has improved massively. I feel much more confident and I'm making friends easily now. I'm also more open to meeting new people and trying new things, which has made my life so much more fun. I think I'm a much happier person than I was a few years ago.

I'm much less anxious and more focused. I don't waste energy worrying about things I can't control, and that has made a huge difference to my mental health. I feel more at peace, and I enjoy my life more. I'm also more grateful for what I have, because I'm not constantly worried about losing it.
Kein Einfluss auf meine psychische Gesundheit
Less depressed, more self-compassionate. I like myself more now.

Quitting drinking has transformed my mental health. I used to be anxious and depressed most of the time, and I didn't realise how much alcohol was contributing to that. Now I'm much more stable. I sleep well, I have energy, and I'm actually happy most days. I'm also more grateful for my life, my health, my relationships. I feel like I've been given a second chance, and I don't want to waste it. The experience was what made me see that, and I'll always be grateful for it.
Ich bin insgesamt zufriedener und weniger gestresst. Mir geht es gut.
No change

My panic disorder has improved a lot. I used to have panic attacks several times a week, and now I have them maybe once every couple of months. Not being afraid of them has been the key. I'm also less anxious in general, and I'm more willing to do things I used to avoid, like taking the train or going to big events. I feel more free and more alive. During the experience, after the panic transformed into bliss, I felt so much love for everything, and I think some of that love is still with me. I'm kinder to myself and to others.
Ich bin entspannter und weniger ängstlich.
I'm more optimistic and hopeful. My depression has lifted a lot.

I feel more at peace with myself and my life. I'm not as anxious as I used to be, and I appreciate the small things more. My mental health is generally better, though I wouldn't say the experience was life-changing for me. More like a nudge in the right direction.

Ich fühle mich körperlich und psychisch gesünder als vor der Erfahrung. Ich grüble weniger und habe mehr Energie. Ich bin dankbarer für meinen Körper und für das, was er leisten kann. Ich habe gemerkt, dass ich mich lange vernachlässigt habe, und kümmere mich jetzt besser um mich. Auch meine depressive Verstimmung, die ich seit Jahren immer wieder hatte, ist deutlich besser geworden.
Generally happier and less tired

I feel less lonely and more supported, both by the people around me and by something I can't quite name. I'm more open to spiritual ideas than I used to be. My grief for my grandmother has transformed into something gentler, a sense of connection rather than loss. My relationship with my mother has deepened a lot, and I feel so much love for her now. My mental health is better overall, I'm less anxious and I feel more at peace.
Ich bin ruhiger geworden und habe weniger depressive Gedanken.
Slightly better, more self-aware
It made my mental health worse for a while, I had insomnia and anxiety for months. Now I'm back to how I was before. No lasting benefit that I can see.
Ich habe weniger Ängste und fühle mich sicherer in mir selbst. Ich kann mich besser beruhigen, wenn es mir nicht gut geht, und bin dadurch psychisch stabiler.
I'm less anxious and more at peace. I've stopped trying to fix everything, and I feel more relaxed and present. I've also become more compassionate towards myself and others.
I'm much less anxious and resentful. My relationships feel more honest and that makes me happier.
Ich bin ausgeglichener

My mental health has improved enormously. I used to have very low self-worth and I was depressed for most of my twenties. During the experience I felt loved, completely and unconditionally, just for existing. It's hard to describe how big that was. Since then I've been much kinder to myself, and my depression has lifted. I feel more connected to people and I let them love me, which I couldn't do before. I'm also more grateful for my life, which I used to see as a burden.
Can't really say, maybe slightly better mood but nothing big
